kurzbeschreibung:
**Shang-Hai China Restaurant in Tirol**

Discover authentic Chinese flavors in the heart of **Tirol**! At **Shang-Hai**, we bring the vibrant tastes of China to your table with a warm, inviting atmosphere.

Indulge in our signature dishes like succulent **Peking Duck**, savory **Kung Pao Chicken**, or delicate **Szechuan Noodles**. Every bite is crafted with care to deliver the rich, aromatic experience you’d expect from a true Chinese eatery.

Whether you’re craving something spicy, sweet, or perfectly balanced, our menu has it all. Pair your meal with one of our premium teas or a refreshing **Jasmine Green Tea** for the full experience.

Located in **Tirol**, we’re your go-to spot for a taste of the East—without leaving the stunning landscapes of the Alps. Come visit us and let **Shang-Hai** transport you to the flavors of China!
